metadata.title: La-Z-Boy Sales Reference Library
metadata.use_note: These user-provided materials are indexed for staff lookup. Their market, effective date, publisher authority, and applicability vary by document. Validate current Canadian availability, configuration, order terms, warranties, and care instructions in the current official documents before relying on or repeating a claim.

guardrails: A product-directory entry is not proof that a model or prefix is currently available in Canada.
The directory does not establish customer fit, weight capacity, model-to-prefix compatibility, price, or inventory.
Unit shipping weight is not a person's supported weight capacity.
Warranty tables and dealer terms here are reference extracts; use the current applicable written warranty, price list, and accepted order documents.

The April 2026 cover workbook contains distinct master cover, color, swatch, collection, and ordering-program tables. A swatch-program entry does not alone establish that a cover is orderable on a particular model or in a particular Canadian market.

dimensions_key.name: Width

dimensions_key.name: Height

dimensions_key.name: Depth
dimensions_key.definition: Source definition: wall to front edge when the unit is flush against the wall. Check the exact measurement convention for the cited product sheet.

dimensions_key.name: Seat height

dimensions_key.name: Seat depth

wood_finishes.name: Graphite

wood_finishes.name: Mesa

fabric_cutting_codes.name: Up the Roll
fabric_cutting_codes.definition: Vertical pattern direction is parallel to selvage; no pattern matching. Source says multi-seat front rails have vertical seams.

fabric_cutting_codes.name: Directional Railroad
fabric_cutting_codes.definition: Cut perpendicular to selvage (railroaded); vertical pattern matching is not possible.

fabric_cutting_codes.name: Plaid Stripe
fabric_cutting_codes.definition: Railroaded and matched vertically and horizontally; source notes reversible seat cushions on mirrored patterns.

fabric_cutting_codes.name: Directional Plaid
fabric_cutting_codes.definition: Upward directional plaid, matched vertically and horizontally with reversible cushions.

fabric_cutting_codes.name: Non-Mirrored Plaid
fabric_cutting_codes.definition: Railroaded and matched vertically only; source says seat cushions are non-reversible.

fabric_cutting_codes.name: Horizontal Stripe
fabric_cutting_codes.definition: Pattern pieces cut parallel to selvage and locked on the stripe line to flow horizontally across inside backs, arms, and seats.

fabric_cutting_codes.name: Urethane
fabric_cutting_codes.definition: Synthetic railroaded cover. Source notes bottom venting or tan denim backing on units with loose seats/backs.

fabric_cutting_codes.name: Breathable Urethane
fabric_cutting_codes.definition: Synthetic railroaded cover. Source notes bottom venting or tan denim backing on units with loose seats/backs.

fabric_cutting_codes.name: Leather Match
fabric_cutting_codes.definition: Source definition: top-grain leather on body-touching areas (seat, back, inside arms), with matching vinyl or polyurethane on outer panels.

fabric_cutting_codes.name: Full Leather
fabric_cutting_codes.definition: Source definition: 100% top-grain leather throughout the unit.

fabric_wearability_reference.label: Normal
fabric_wearability_reference.statement: The supplied April 2026 workbook says recommended for all La-Z-Boy upholstered furniture.

fabric_wearability_reference.label: Medium
fabric_wearability_reference.statement: The supplied workbook says recommended for sofas, sleep sofas, duo, La-Z-Boy Classics, and occasional chairs, and not allowed for recliners, motion sofas, or motion modulars. Check the exact cover's current application flags.

fabric_wearability_reference.label: Performance
fabric_wearability_reference.statement: The supplied workbook says recommended for all La-Z-Boy upholstered furniture and describes additional durability testing. Do not infer a stain warranty from this marker.

cover_specialty_markers.name: Bleach Cleanable
cover_specialty_markers.source: April 2026 cover workbook key; check the cover-specific care instructions

cover_information_source.edition: April 2026 market, as titled in the workbook
cover_information_source.source_scope: The extracted workbook includes a master fabric SKU list, master leather SKU list, dealer swatch inventory, ring pages, Design Center, 6x6 and inline swatches, leather and fabric waterfall programs, Select Stationary and Select Reclining leather, test-store hangers, residual value packs, fringe and cord, invoicing breakdowns, swatch icon descriptions, support data, and swatch SKU numbering.
cover_information_source.status_note: The workbook uses separate current-offering, phase-out, new-phase-out, immediate-drop, and April 2026 drop tables. Do not infer a cover is current from an old intro date, swatch appearance, or presence in a different collection table; check its exact row, program, color, and status.
cover_information_source.application_note: Cover selection is model-, product-line-, CAP-, color-, and program-dependent. The app's generic cap-code choices are not a per-model cover authorization list.

terms_of_sale.status: user-provided dealer terms summary; contract and jurisdiction not verified
pricing_payment: Prices governed by price list effective when La-Z-Boy accepts the purchase order.
Prices are FOB point of origin, as stated in the supplied summary.
Title passes to dealer upon delivery to common carrier, as stated in the supplied summary.
Past-due accounts: summary states 0.75% per month (9% per annum), plus collection/attorney fees.
terms_of_sale.stock_orders: Summary states cancellation or changes require written notice at least four weeks before ETS (Expect-to-Ship), if production has not started.
terms_of_sale.custom_orders: Summary states a 24-hour cancellation window from acknowledgement; after that custom orders cannot be cancelled or altered.
terms_of_sale.signature_leather: Summary states cancellation is not permitted after an ETS date is assigned.
defects_and_returns: Summary states defective goods or order errors must be reported in writing within 30 days of invoice date.
Returns require prior authorization and a Return Authorization Number; unapproved returns are rejected.
terms_of_sale.instruction: This is an operational reference, not a legal interpretation or promise to a consumer. Confirm the accepted purchase order, current dealer policy, and applicable contract.

material_education.status: user-provided staff-training/marketing copy; not independently fact-checked; avoid presenting comparative, lifespan, environmental, or health statements as verified facts

concepts_as_listed.summary: Training page describes leather and faux leather as upholstery alternatives; says natural hide markings can be present and describes aniline as through-dyed with visible natural variation and semi-aniline as having a second pigmented layer and a more consistent appearance.
concepts_as_listed.caution: Confirm leather type, body-touching panels, finish, care, and warranties for the exact cover. Natural variation is not evidence of a defect or a specific performance guarantee.

concepts_as_listed.summary: Training page describes Renew as a fabric intended to mimic leather and offer a lower-cost or non-leather alternative.
concepts_as_listed.caution: The supplied page's claims about washability, tumble drying, stain/fade resistance, durability, eco-friendliness, and cleaning with soap and water require cover-specific manufacturer instructions; do not generalize them.

concepts_as_listed.summary: Training page says urethane may be matched to outside arms/backs and inconspicuous areas.
concepts_as_listed.caution: Check exact cover construction and the current fabric/leather content disclosure; do not promise that the body never contacts urethane without exact product evidence.

concepts_as_listed.summary: Source lists possible hide marks such as insect marks, scratches, brands, stretch marks, and fat wrinkles as natural variation.
concepts_as_listed.caution: Explain variation neutrally and refer to the current care and quality standards for the selected leather.

unverified_promotional_claims: Leather lasts four times as long as fabric
An adult may purchase four cloth sofas for one leather sofa over a lifetime
Leather is easier for people with allergies
Renew can be washed and tumble dried
Renew cleans with soap and water
material_education.aniline_marker_note: The training page says to look for a brown dot for authentic/aniline and a teal dot for performance/semi-aniline. Confirm the current swatch legend before use.

search_index.title: Dimension abbreviations
search_index.keywords: W H D SW SH SD AH RD WT width height depth seat seat width seat height seat depth arm recline clearance unit shipping weight
search_index.detail: Use the supplied dimensions key. WT is unit shipping weight, not user-weight capacity; definitions are source-specific and must be checked against the exact product sheet.

search_index.title: Wood finish codes
search_index.keywords: 007 021 041 071 142 brown mahogany coffee graphite driftwood mesa finish
search_index.detail: 007 Brown Mahogany; 021 Coffee; 041 Graphite; 071 Driftwood; 142 Mesa. Source restricts Mesa to styles 295–423. Confirm style-level finish availability.

search_index.title: Fabric CAP and cutting codes
search_index.keywords: CAP UR DR VS PS DP NP HS UE BU LM LL fabric leather railroaded plaid stripe leather match full
search_index.detail: CAP describes cutting/layout conventions, not a product SKU or proof of model/cover compatibility. See the supplied CAP-code definitions.

search_index.title: Wearability and upholstery application
search_index.keywords: normal medium performance black green p dot recliner motion sofa modular
search_index.detail: The source says Medium/Green-dot is not allowed on recliners, motion sofas, or motion modulars; Normal and Performance are described as all-upholstery. Check the exact cover row and product application flags.

search_index.title: Specialty cover markers
search_index.keywords: iClean Conserve antimicrobial pet friendly Nanobionic bleach cleanable I C A PF N W*B
search_index.detail: Workbook markers: I iClean; C Conserve; A Antimicrobial; PF Pet Friendly; N Nanobionic; W*B Bleach Cleanable. A marker alone does not establish care, warranty, or exact product eligibility.

search_index.title: Cover and swatch status
search_index.keywords: active dropped phase out phase-out immediate drop April 2026 swatch ring pages Design Center 6x6 leather
search_index.detail: The workbook separates master cover records from Dealer Swatch Inventory, ring pages, Design Center, size-specific swatch and waterfall programs, phase-outs, and drops. Check the matching row, color, collection, and program.

search_index.title: Warranty quick reference
search_index.keywords: warranty lifetime 5 year 3 year 1 year recliner lift chair classics stationary sleeper sectional duo fabric leather
search_index.detail: The supplied category-specific warranty matrix is stored in warranty_matrix. Market and effective terms are unstated; consult the current written warranty before quoting coverage.

search_index.title: iClean stain coverage summary
search_index.keywords: iClean stains coffee wine urine ink mustard oil wax 3 year labor warranty
search_index.detail: The supplied summary lists selected household stains as covered and oil-based products, wax-based products, permanent ink, and mustard as not covered; validate against current warranty terms.

search_index.title: Dealer order, cancellation, and return terms
search_index.keywords: price list FOB title payment 0.75% 9% stock order ETS cancellation custom 24 hours signature leather returns RA 30 days
search_index.detail: The provided terms summary is for operational reference only. Verify the accepted purchase order, current dealer policy, and applicable contract before making a promise.

search_index.title: Leather, Renew, urethane and aniline
search_index.keywords: leather faux Renew urethane aniline semi-aniline natural grain hide markings brown dot teal dot
search_index.detail: The source provides staff training and marketing descriptions. Comparative lifetime, eco-friendly, flame/tear, allergy, wash/tumble, soap-and-water, and body-contact claims are explicitly flagged in material_education as unverified; use exact-cover documentation.

search_index.title: Product style directory
search_index.detail: The full style-number/name/category list and four prefix families are available in product_directory. It is a lookup index only—not a current Canadian assortment, fit guide, stock list, capacity table, or complete model-prefix matrix.

search_index.title: Model-specific leather cover applications
search_index.keywords: 512 Pinnacle Opulence 519 Astor Cranbrook 530 Greyson Salvo Roberto 724 Trouper Intermingle 805 Ace leather top stitching
search_index.detail: April 2026 workbook Select Leather Reclining rows include explicit cover/color/model pairings for Pinnacle, Astor, Greyson, Trouper, and Ace. These are cover-program examples only; they do not prove current orderability, all options, fit, or general Canada availability.

search_index.title: Product lookup limitations
search_index.keywords: style directory model number category alias duplicate verify
search_index.detail: The supplied directory has repeated code/name rows and category descriptions that differ from current catalog nomenclature. Treat entries as search leads and verify the exact active SKU/configuration in the current product catalog.
